body: apps2/mud/main.go: petSlot *pet.Slot on player struct. bst <mob-id> charms target (BST job gate, HP≤70% check). jug-pet <kind> summons jug pet. pet-release dismisses. pet-status shows HP. pet-heel toggles non-attacking mode. pet-heal cures pet (8 MP). tickAll() pet auto-attack fires on owner target each swing tick, rewards owner XP on mob kill. All tests pass.
title: S104-02: BST MUD wiring — bst/jug-pet/pet-release/pet-status/pet-heel/pet-heal commands + pet auto-attack tick
